name: flo2-connector
description: The flo2 family's plugins: helpers an AI agent connects to for designing physical things, each built and released in its own repository.

plugins.name: flo2-cad
plugins.description: Design casting-ready jewelry with an agent: a ring in a named size with a prong or bezel head, round or emerald-cut stones sized from their grading report, checked against cited casting limits before any STL or 3MF is released.

plugins.name: flo2-ifc
plugins.description: IfcOpenShell's ifcmcp, the MCP server for IFC building models, on the MCP Python SDK 2.x: load, query, edit, validate, quantify and plot a building model, with every dependency pinned to the set flo2.io runs.
